text:
alex_devex: Heads-up — we're locking the devex RC today. Need owners to confirm diffs for SDKs/docs/sample-apps and call out any blockers.
Proposed cutoffs:
- changelog freeze: 18:00 UTC
- sample-apps freeze: 16:00 UTC
- doc deploy: 19:00 UTC
Please ping ownership and list any deps/blockers.

maria_pm: On my side, SDK v2.4 PRs are merged except one: #834 — users reported a regression in streaming. cc @chris_eng. Can we postpone the changelog entry if the fix lands after cutoff?

chris_eng: I have a patch queued, but tests are flaky atm. If we get green by 17:30 UTC I can cherry-pick. Otherwise we'll skip and ship post-rc bugfix. :thumbsup:

lee_docs: I'll draft the changelog notes for all included commits. If we skip #834 I'll mark it 'post-rc bugfix'. Also updating quickstart sample to reflect new telemetry flags. ETA for docs deploy ~18:45 UTC.

sam_sample: Sample apps PRs (node/python) are ready, but one E2E failing in docker compose (timeout). @infra_qa can you run the suite? Logs:
```
docker logs sample-node
# shows connection reset on init
```

infra_qa: Running E2E now — reproducing timeout. Cause: missing REDIS_URL in compose for CI env. Pushing quick env fix and re-running. Will report back in 10m.

deploy-bot: Deploy window scheduled at 20:00 UTC to staging if freezes are honored. Reminder: no feature branches after freeze.

alex_devex: Ok owners — if you expect not to hit cutoff reply with 'hold' + reason. Otherwise I'll mark green at 16:05 UTC. @maria_pm @chris_eng @lee_docs @sam_sample

chris_eng: hold — tests flaky, likely need more than 30m. Will update status @17:15 UTC.

maria_pm: If chris can't make it, fine to skip and schedule patch next week. Please file a follow-up issue.

alex_devex: Noted. If we skip, file issue with priority & assignee and add doc note. I'll update the release checklist and call a go/no-go at 18:30 UTC. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
